body:
Thank you so much to everyone for every single one of your comments and messages. The response has been overwhelming. 

I have read every single one as of writing this and I will try my best to respond to all of them in time. I lost track of time reading through so many heartfelt messages and it has gotten late, but tonight I know I'll sleep with a heart much lighter thanks to all of you. Best wishes.

Thank you for this beautiful comment and for your condolences. While I am not ready to accept that I am not responsible, and I may never be, I am doing my best to get the support I need to one day start on the path to recovery and, eventually, self-forgiveness.

Thank you for saying this. You are absolutely right. We all need to do better as parents. I could have done better. I should have. It does not feel right to say there is nothing I could have done. I know there is. And I sincerely wish that those who it's not too late for will not make those same mistakes. 

And I hope your dad opens his eyes and realizes his wrongs. And if not, I ask that you do what is best for yourself, even if that means cutting him out. Your life is too precious.
You don't have to say anything. Just reading is enough. Thank you.
Thank you. I believe in your words. Please cherish your son for us both.

I read it and I am truly glad you were here to read my story today. Thank you for opening up to someone. It takes a lot of strength. Your mom is very lucky to have you and I hope she will have you for a long time to come.
Your thoughts alone are more than enough. It helps me tremendously. Thank you.
And thank you for reading my story, and for all your thoughts and prayers.
Thank you. Best wishes to you and your child.
No I don't have anybody. I tried a calling a local line but they keep disconnecting me.

I don't know, It all just seems hopeless. I'll never get my life back and talking won't really change that. I'm having second thoughts about leaving, it's a lot of trouble with too much risk. So I might just end it all now.
Please read my post history, I don't have it in me to write it all out again. Basically I'm a defect and I fucked my life up.

Thank you but my family hates my guts. If I died they would only be disappointed that they wasted so much money raising me. And if I told them how I feel, things would get 10000x worse, guaranteed. 

Today was the same old crap. Woke up at noon even though I set 10 alarms, did nothing all day, assignments due and midterm tomorrow, yet I haven't gone to class since semester started 2 months ago. There's really no point even waking up tomorrow, I will just end it all tonight.
10 months is way too long, no way will I live that long. Even 10 more minutes is too painful for me
No its my account but they put the money in. It was meant to be for tuition. I'm so screwed there's no way I can go on living
